title: Media: Manage the Files of Your Site | Orchard Core
description:
Pictures, documents, audio and video end up uploaded again for every page, in copies that drift apart, and a stored file is hard to find later.

The Media module gives the site one library. You upload a file once, keep it in a folder, attach it to content, and let a media profile resize it when the theme shows it.

In this video:
• Why the Media module exists
• Where it lives: the Media menu, the settings and the optional features
• The Media Library: folders, files, search, uploads and menus
• Media in content: attaching a file with a media field and seeing it on the site
